$doc: Vyomi capability registry — Amazon ECR + Inspector2 image findings. See s3.json for the contract. Control plane = core/ecr_core.py via AwsWireRouter (JSON 1.1, signing name ecr); registry v2 data plane on the ECR host name (<acct>.dkr.ecr.<region>.<host>) with AWS:<token> basic auth; image layers and manifests are stored in the simulator S3 (bucket vyomi-ecr-<account>).

ecr.repositories.title: Repositories — create/describe/delete (force), tag mutability, scan-on-push, encryption config, tags, repository + registry policies

ecr.images.title: Images — PutImage/BatchGetImage/BatchDeleteImage/ListImages/DescribeImages with real manifests; layer upload API (Initiate/UploadPart/Complete/BatchCheck)
limitations: Layer tarballs are stored byte-for-byte and digest-verified but never unpacked or executed.
GetDownloadUrlForLayer returns the registry blob URL, not a presigned S3 URL.

ecr.registry_v2.title: Docker/OCI registry v2 push and pull after `aws ecr get-login-password | docker login` (blob uploads, manifests, tags/list, _catalog)
limitations: The registry answers on the ECR host name (<account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.<simulator host>, e.g. *.localhost); a plain host is the Azure ACR / GCP registry wire.
Nano: the registry wire only works through the Nano relay/tunnel; a docker client cannot reach the browser tab directly, so use the ECR API (PutImage + layer upload) there.
Cross-repository blob mount and pull-through cache rules are not simulated.

ecr.lifecycle.title: Lifecycle policies — validated rules, StartLifecyclePolicyPreview, expiry executed on the scheduler tick
limitations: Real ECR evaluates policies asynchronously (up to ~24h); here evaluation runs on the shared scheduler tick (offline) or while the Nano page is open, and on preview.

ecr.replication.title: Cross-region replication to the same account (PutReplicationConfiguration, DescribeImageReplicationStatus)
limitations: Replication stays inside this simulator account: a destination registry id that is not the simulator account reports FAILED (REPLICATION_NOT_SUPPORTED).

ecr.scanning.title: Image scanning — basic scan on push / StartImageScan / DescribeImageScanFindings, registry scanning configuration
limitations: Findings come from Vyomi's bundled advisory snapshot over the image's stored config (packages from pinned install commands / SBOM label), not Amazon's feed.
Offline appliance can substitute a real Trivy report; Nano uses the advisory engine only. Layer contents are not unpacked.

ecr.inspector.title: Inspector2 enhanced scanning findings for ECR images (Enable, ListFindings with filter criteria, coverage, aggregation, CONTINUOUS_SCAN rescans)
limitations: ECR image findings only (no EC2/Lambda scanning); finding scores/severities come from the bundled advisory snapshot.
